description: Top AWS linked accounts by Cost Explorer unblended spend over the last N days. Known ids: 985408759551 apm-stage ($2k/day SLO), 041298796264 monitoring ($900/day SLO).

configuration.query:
FROM metrics-aws.billing-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= NOW() - TO_DATEPERIOD(CONCAT(TO_STRING(?days), " days"))
    AND aws.billing.group_definition.key == "LINKED_ACCOUNT"
| STATS spend = SUM(aws.billing.UnblendedCost.amount) BY cloud.account.id
| SORT spend DESC
| LIMIT 12
